project.name: AutoVault
project.description: Smart vehicle management system (CRUD + Dashboard) replacing manual tracking with a modern, interactive dashboard.
project.archetype_selection: Archetype 5 (Jewel & Luxury) + Archetype 4 (Swiss Data Control). High-end automotive precision meets data clarity. Dark, premium, glass-like UI.

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align data and typography for scanning; only center-align empty states or hero text.

surfaces.glass_card: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#1D2D44]/50 border border-[#748CAB]/20 rounded-2xl shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.15)]
surfaces.header_glass: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#0D1321]/70 border-b border-[#748CAB]/20 sticky top-0 z-50
surfaces.interactive_button: bg-[#3E5C76] text-[#F0EBD8] rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(62,92,118,0.5)] hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98]
surfaces.secondary_button: bg-transparent border border-[#748CAB]/40 text-[#F0EBD8] rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-all duration-300 hover:bg-[#1D2D44]

motion_and_interaction.chart_animation: Use recharts built-in animation. Delay staggered rendering for bar/line charts.

login_hero.description: Cinematic wide shot of a futuristic automotive garage, dark moody lighting
login_hero.usage: Login page background (left side of split screen or fullscreen background with heavy overlay)

vehicle_placeholders.description: Black mercedes-benz e63 amg parked on a wet street
Dark audi car parked between modern buildings
Silver convertible sports car parked at night

garage_ambience.usage: Fallback or empty state background for My Garage page

icons.instruction: Use Phosphor Icons (duotone) for a high-end technical dashboard look. Install via: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

charts.instruction: Use Shadcn Chart primitives (which wrap Recharts). Ensure grid lines are `#748CAB` at 10% opacity. Tooltips must use the glass_card style.

auth_page.layout: Split screen or centered glass modal. If split, use `login_hero` image on the left with `bg-[#0D1321]/40` overlay to preserve image visibility. Input fields should be `bg-[#1D2D44]/30` with `#748CAB`/30 borders.

dashboard_home.stats_cards: Use 'The Control Room' grid setup. Span 1 for stats. Animate metric counters on mount (e.g., using framer-motion or a react count-up hook).
dashboard_home.activity_feed: Tall narrow list spanning row-span-2. Use `label_overline` for timestamps.

vehicle_garage.grid: Bento Grid: mix wide cards (span-2) for primary vehicles, square for secondary.
vehicle_garage.card_image: Images should have `max-h-[200px] object-cover rounded-t-xl`. Use a gradient overlay `bg-gradient-to-t from-[#1D2D44] to-transparent` to blend image into the card.

forms_and_crud.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized. No white backgrounds. Inputs must be `bg-[#0D1321]` or `bg-[#1D2D44]/40` with `#748CAB` borders.
forms_and_crud.modals: Dialog overlays must be `backdrop-blur-sm bg-[#0D1321]/80`. The DialogContent itself uses `glass_card` classes.

testing.attributes: ALL interactive elements (buttons, nav links, form inputs, table rows) MUST include `data-testid` attributes formatted as kebab-case based on their role (e.g., `data-testid="add-vehicle-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Extend tailwind.config.js to include the 5 specific brand colors exactly as named in the design_system.colors object.
Do NOT use any default Vercel/Stripe styles. Stick strictly to the Dark Glassmorphism aesthetic.
Ensure all text has sufficient contrast; DO NOT use pure #000000 or #ffffff.
Implement Framer Motion for page transitions and modal springs.
Use Shadcn UI but override the default styles with the provided glassmorphism surfaces.
